title: Vipera: Blending Visual and LLM-Driven Guidance for Systematic Auditing of Text-to-Image Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the gender distribution of generated characters for specific occupational prompts (e.g., "doctor", "nurse") using automated LLM labeling and interactive scene graphs.
Evaluating the racial diversity and homogeneity of characters generated from broad prompts (e.g., "family having a picnic") through visual inspection and LLM-assisted categorization.
Comparing the visual attributes, equipment (e.g., stethoscopes), and demographic distributions of characters generated across different profession-based prompts to identify stereotypes.
Assessing cultural representation in images generated from prompts involving global or culturally varied events (e.g., "Worldwide athletes in the Olympic Games", "A couple on their wedding day").
User-driven qualitative assessment of generated images to identify visual indicators of wealth discrimination or lack of socioeconomic diversity in general scene generation.
